questions.topic: Chunk-and-Embed as an Idempotent Batch Job
questions.question: What should determine an embedding artifact's identity?
options: Chunk identity plus model revision and preprocessing version

questions.topic: Chunk-and-Embed as an Idempotent Batch Job
questions.question: What does idempotent embedding output mean?
options: Every retry appends a new vector
The same logical inputs converge to the same committed vector records

questions.topic: Chunk-and-Embed as an Idempotent Batch Job
questions.question: Why should batches be packed by tokens instead of only chunk count?
options: Model request limits are based on token volume and chunks vary in size

questions.topic: Chunk-and-Embed as an Idempotent Batch Job
questions.question: Which output validation is essential?
options: Every vector has a different dimension
The response uses current wall time
Count, item mapping, dimension, finite values, and norm checks pass

questions.topic: Chunk-and-Embed as an Idempotent Batch Job
questions.question: An embedding request times out after the server may have processed it. What makes retry safe?
options: Append results under an attempt ID

questions.topic: Chunk-and-Embed as an Idempotent Batch Job
questions.question: Why is a cache keyed only by chunk text unsafe?
options: It can reuse a vector from an incompatible model or preprocessing version
Every model produces the same space

questions.question: Why must vector records include metadata?
options: Filtering, citation, invalidation, and lineage require it

questions.question: Which metadata is fundamental to vector interpretation?
options: Model version, dimension, normalization, metric, and chunk identity

questions.question: Why keep a normalized corpus catalog even if the vector index repeats fields?
options: It remains authoritative for complete lineage and reconstructable serving state

questions.question: What should happen after a document permission revocation?
options: Wait for the next model upgrade
Propagate the change promptly to every retrievable vector or trusted authorization layer

questions.question: Why should 768-dimensional cosine vectors and 1536-dimensional inner-product vectors use typed namespaces?
options: Their dimensions, normalization, and distance contracts are incompatible
Vector stores support only one record

questions.question: What does an orphan-vector reconciliation check?
options: Whether every query has a click
Whether all vector values are positive
Whether every source has one chunk
Whether each active vector resolves to an active, permitted source artifact

questions.topic: Pre-Filter vs Post-Filter in ANN Search
questions.question: What is pre-filtering in ANN search?
options: Restrict eligibility before or during nearest-neighbor search
Remove results only after returning them to the user

questions.topic: Pre-Filter vs Post-Filter in ANN Search
questions.question: What is post-filtering?
options: Retrieve broader ANN candidates, then discard ineligible results

questions.topic: Pre-Filter vs Post-Filter in ANN Search
questions.question: Eligible fraction is 5 percent and k is 20. What rough post-filter candidate count does k divided by p suggest?

questions.topic: Pre-Filter vs Post-Filter in ANN Search
questions.question: When can exact filtered search be preferable to ANN?
options: When the eligible subset is very small

questions.topic: Pre-Filter vs Post-Filter in ANN Search
questions.question: Why is k divided by eligible fraction only a rough oversampling guide?
options: Eligibility and similarity can be skewed and ANN itself can miss candidates

questions.topic: Pre-Filter vs Post-Filter in ANN Search
questions.question: What is required for secure post-filtering?
options: Unauthorized candidates may be logged freely
Filtering occurs inside a trusted boundary before any prohibited disclosure
The reranker receives all private text
